definitions.occipitoparietal transition region: A regional part of the cerebral hemisphere located at the anatomical boundary between the occipital lobe and the parietal lobe, representing cortical areas that transition between these two lobar divisions.
definitions.occipitotemporal transition region: A regional part of the cerebral hemisphere located at the anatomical boundary between the occipital lobe and the temporal lobe, representing cortical areas that transition between these two lobar divisions.

confirmed_matches.label: occipitotemporal (fusiform) gyrus, occipital part
confirmed_matches.uberon_definition: The fusiform gyrus is part of the temporal lobe. It is also known as the (discontinuous) occipitotemporal gyrus. The occipital fusiform gyrus is the occipital part of this structure.
confirmed_matches.wikipedia_summary: The fusiform gyrus, also known as the occipitotemporal gyrus, is part of the temporal and occipital lobes of the brain. It is involved in visual processing, particularly in face and word recognition.
confirmed_matches.note: Exact synonym match in UBERON:0022364. FMA:71033 cross-reference already present in UBERON term.
